Greekdiamerizō, translated as “cloven” in the King James Version, means to “divide into parts, distribute” (see Longman and Strauss,The Baker Expository Dictionary, 1064; see also 237).

The Greek for tongue isglōssa. It could mean the actual organ of the tongue or the idea of human language, which would be difficult to conceptualize as a physical object resting on the disciples (see Longman and Strauss,The Baker Expository Dictionary, 837–38).

Different Christian denominations commemorate Passion Week in different ways (see Richard Neitzel Holzapfel and Thomas A. Wayment, “Foreword,” inCelebrating Easter, ed. Thomas A. Wayment and Keith J. Wilson, [2007], ix–x).
